# Skill: report-branding

Shared, toolkit-owned presentation rules for roadmap, hop, assessment, deploy-prep and
generic reports. Apply to interactive HTML, print HTML/PDF and their Markdown twins;
optional presentations must preserve the same report identity and evidence labels.
This is not the corporate PowerPoint template or a certification of Adobe brand compliance.

Read @.github/instructions/untrusted-data.instructions.md
Read @.github/instructions/write-scope.instructions.md

## Identity and asset boundary

- Use **Adobe Commerce Upgrade Toolkit** as the toolkit name everywhere. A text-only
  attribution is sufficient; do not draw an Adobe logo or manufacture a certification seal.
- Do not import corporate templates, logos, fonts, confidential footers or internal skills.
  External assets require separate redistribution approval before packaging.
- Use system fonts, inline CSS and existing report data. No font downloads, external
  resources, telemetry, new MCP requirements or dependency installation.
- Do not add `Adobe Confidential`, `Internal Only`, a presenter identity or a customer
  classification by default. A classification requires an explicit human instruction for
  that artifact and must remain visible in its exported formats.
- This skill changes presentation only. It neither generates a new assessment nor changes
  document ownership, output paths, conversion permissions or execution gates.

## Shared visual tokens

Embed this token block once inside each HTML document's inline `<style>`. The roadmap
template already embeds it. Do not link to a shared stylesheet: reports must remain portable.
Use the red accent for identity, dividers and focus, not as an assessment result.

```css
:root {
  --brand-accent: #eb1000;
  --report-ink: #181818;
  --report-muted: #505050;
  --report-surface: #ffffff;
  --report-background: #f5f5f5;
  --report-border: #d5d5d5;
  --report-font: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
}
```

- Body: system font token, ink on surface, 14px minimum on screen; print body 10pt.
- Header/cover: white background, dark text and a red top border; do not use a full-page
  gradient. Show report title, confirmed project/client name, version pair, date and report
  type. Include installed toolkit version when known; never invent missing metadata.
- Footer: `Generated by Adobe Commerce Upgrade Toolkit`, followed by the report date
  and toolkit version when available. Existing evidence/guardrail attribution is retained.
- Use clear heading levels, left-aligned tables, repeated print table headers and wrapped
  code/paths. Keep whole chapters splittable; avoid breaking individual short rows/cards.
- Normal text and badge text require contrast of at least 4.5:1. Do not put small red
  accent text on a dark background or communicate status by colour alone.

Status/severity text and background pairs:

| Meaning | Text | Background |
|---------|------|------------|
| Critical / blocked / failed | `#b91c1c` | `#fee2e2` |
| High | `#9a3412` | `#ffedd5` |
| Medium / partial / pending | `#92400e` | `#fef3c7` |
| Low / planned | `#1d4ed8` | `#dbeafe` |
| Passed / fixed / validated | `#166534` | `#dcfce7` |
| Unknown / not assessed | `#505050` | `#f5f5f5` |
| Manual / decision pending / superseded | `#6b21a8` | `#f3e8ff` |

## Evidence visibility across formats

- Put the report type and evidence status immediately below the title, before findings.
  Roadmaps say **Planning only - not a compatibility assessment**. Assessment/pre-hop
  reports with unavailable UCT say **Incomplete - UCT Not assessed**, with the reason and
  human-run follow-up. Post-hop status comes from actual validation, never the branding.
- Keep blockers and evidence gaps visible without opening tabs or expanding rows: add a
  non-dismissible summary near the title, and retain the details in their relevant sections.
  Use only normalized accepted evidence and fixed quarantine reasons/counts supplied by the
  orchestrator; never read raw UCT or quarantine records for presentation.
- Unknown counts stay unavailable, not zero. Empty sections say **Not assessed** when
  evidence is missing; **None identified** is permitted only for completed checks whose
  accepted evidence supports that statement. Quarantine remains a human-review blocker.
- The client report may omit raw technical details, but must retain a plain-language
  quarantine blocker and each unresolved gap's reason and follow-up. Do not suppress
  limitations to make an executive summary appear positive.
- HTML, Markdown, print HTML, PDF and any optional presentation must agree on the version
  pair, findings, assessment status, blockers, gaps and approval ownership. Branding must
  never turn planning or a scan result into execution approval or production readiness.
- Keep this limitation visible: **This report is not proof of production readiness.**

## Print and persistence checks

- Print all report content, not just the active tab or current filtered rows. Hide navigation,
  filters and buttons; reveal all tabs, collapsed detail and filtered-out findings in print.
  Never hide evidence-status banners, blocker summaries or limitations.
- Use A4, readable margins, white surfaces and dark text. Keep status words/borders legible
  even with background graphics disabled. Print does not require JavaScript.
- Markdown retains the title metadata, status, blocker summary, section details, limitation
  and text footer; do not embed HTML-only styling or proprietary assets.
- Before persistence, check identity, evidence visibility, contrast and print rules. The
  documentation agent composes the document; the existing **Document report persistence
  handoff** applies if it cannot write. The approved parent verifies read-back before success.
- This addition does not install or enable PPTX export, change PDF/DOCX conversion ownership,
  or permit the documentation agent to execute converters.
